title: Run Stays Within the Space Window
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean choices, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s$ be a natural number. Suppose there is a space bound $\mathrm{sp}$ such that every choice-word run of $N$ on every input of length $n$ uses at most $\mathrm{sp}(n)$ space, and suppose $\mathrm{sp}(|x|)\le s$. Then, for every choice word $w$, the configuration reached by running $N$ on $x$ under $w$ has every work-tape head at distance at most $s$ from the origin, and every work-tape cell at distance greater than $s$ from the origin is blank.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean choices
$\mathrm{sp}:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ bounds the space used on every input and choice word
